name: @deterministic-code/generate-migraters
description: Generators that stream migrate dependency information and package content for typescript, rust, and csharp.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/typescript dist/rust dist/csharp dist/templates && cp -R typescript/templates dist/typescript/ && cp -R rust/templates dist/rust/ && cp -R csharp/templates dist/csharp/ && cp -RL templates dist/
